**Finding submitted: WARRANTY — deviation (walk-away position), fallback redline proposed.**

- **What the document does:** Article VIX (p0109–p0116) is exclusively a disclaimer — "AS IS", all warranties express or implied disclaimed, and an express statement that Licensor does not warrant errors or nonconformity to Documentation "CAN OR WILL BE CORRECTED." No affirmative warranty exists anywhere else; Article VII Technical Support only requires "commercially reasonable efforts to provide Error Corrections" (p0093), an efforts-based support covenant with no repair/replace/refund remedy, so it is not a substitute warranty.
- **Target level:** fallback (shortest complete cure), not preferred — inserted 90-day Software conformance-to-Documentation warranty, 30-day support services warranty, and repair/replacement or refund remedy.
- **Disclaimer conflict cured surgically:** two narrow "EXCEPT AS EXPRESSLY WARRANTED IN THIS ARTICLE" carve-outs at p0110 and p0113 so the retained disclaimer sentences (including the nonconformity-correction disclaimer) do not swallow the new warranty; no broad "notwithstanding" override, and all untouched wording preserved verbatim.
